acceptance_walk:
Bench "review-l4-money-pause" (stand-in, daemon 48990, UI 2590), started from my worktree at db2d5dd (fix/l4-money-pause) with failure injection: FORERUNNER_BENCH_LONG="Build the shop,Write the club history", FORERUNNER_BENCH_USAGE="Build the shop:100000,Write the club history:2000,Write the pairing list:60000", FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_REJECT="Write the pairing list" and FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_USAGE="Write the footer:40000". Each project and task was created through the daemon API, the estimates were patched in sqlite, and each session was started through the UI Start dialog. Walk script: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/9d17d664-b8c3-5e0d-8f13-1f917f72dcc2/scratchpad/walk.cjs (plus walk2.cjs). Screenshots and texts: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-money-pause/steps/. Results: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-money-pause/walk-{a,b,c,d}.json.

(A) L4-money-102/104: project Bakery, "Build the shop" (high priority, estimate USD 8), then "Write a tagline" (estimate USD 0.05). Start CHF 1.60.
- Start dialog (02-a-start-dialog.png): '"Write a tagline" comes after it: it runs if "Build the shop" leaves budget, else in your next session.'
- The larger task heard the wrap-up at CHF 1.07, paused at CHF 1.16 of the CHF 1.28 work budget, and the tagline ran and was accepted in the same session.
- Session page (03-a-session-page.png): status "Ended: 1 paused"; CHF 1.17 of CHF 1.60. No "budget is used", "used the rest" or "Stopped: the budget is used" on the session page, the Sessions list or the Inbox.
- Details: "It promised 2 tasks, about CHF 1.28." and "Session review measured: 1 of 2 planned tasks done; ... against an estimate of CHF 1.28" give one count and one figure, and there is no "cut to fit the budget".
- The Inbox has one card: '"Build the shop" paused before this session's budget ran out', Continue (CHF 6.59 more) / Cancel task.
- Matches design §4.2 and the owner's option C ("spare budget isn't wasted").

(B) L4-money-103: project Club with a project budget of USD 0.075 (CHF 0.06), a writer task with no budget of its own, Start CHF 5.00.
- The run's line under Details reads 'This run may spend CHF 0.03, what is left of the project's budget less the CHF 0.03 kept for its review: before a step that could take it past CHF 0.02 it is told to wrap up, keeping a reserve of…'. The line is cut on screen (33-b-session-details-on.txt:48).
- The run heard its wrap-up and paused '"Write the club history" paused before the project's budget of CHF 0.06 ran out: it spent CHF 0.02 and listed 2 things left to do; CHF 0.03 is kept for its review.'
- Card: '"Write the club history" paused before the project's budget ran out', Cancel task only.
- Session: "Stopped at the project's budget", result '... Stopped at the project's budget of CHF 0.06. CHF 0.02.'
- Nothing passed the limit; before the fix the same run read "This run may spend CHF 1.28 ..." and stopped hard.

(C) L4-money-111: a task "Write the footer" with a budget of USD 0.04 whose review does not fit.
- Card title '"Write the footer" is done; its review waits for room in its budget'.
- Row "Review waits for room in its budget" (21-c-tasks-after.png).
- Result '"Write the footer" is done; its review waits for room in its budget of CHF 0.03: continue or cancel it in the Inbox.'
- Notification '"Write the…" is done; its review waits for room in…'.
- Nothing says "paused at its budget". The person-level log line still reads 'paused before its review: its own budget of CHF 0.03 has no room for it.' That is acceptable.

(D) L4-money-112: Swiss pairing, sent back once, accepted at 18 times its estimate.
- Details: 'Session review: planned tasks cost CHF 0.37, over their estimate of CHF 0.02 by 1719%, with one task tried twice (grade 85, 1 finding).'
- More > Reviews > Session checks: "85 / 100 noted", finding badge "noted" (31-d-reviews-session-checks.txt). The finding's action line still starts "To fix:".

(E) Settings: the budget rows read '(CHF 5.00 unless set)'. GET /settings gives "... kept for the critic's reviews. Shown for information: ...", and "review and fixes" does not appear.

Bench stopped with scripts/bench/stop.mjs, and its home was deleted.

Tests:
- The 11 area test files pass on the fix: 240 tests.
- With the base sources (claude/nifty-knuth-f9udt0) checked out under the new tests, these fail as claimed: the L4-money-101 parse, brief and composed cases; L4-money-102's two oversized-task cases; L4-money-103's project and month cases; the BA-3 review-waits case; the real-daemon L4-money-102, -103 and -109 cases; reviews.test.tsx. The sources were restored afterwards and the worktree is clean.
- The real-daemon L4-money-112 case passes on the base too (see blocking).
- Full runs on the fix: pnpm test 557 files / 5997 passed; pnpm test:integration 5 passed, 6 skipped (Postgres); pnpm test:e2e 13 files, 25 passed, 1 skipped. Every run was under flock.

non_blocking: L4-money-101's general rule (isWholeSetNothing) reads lines that say the work is NOT done as an empty list, because WORK_STATE only knows a few verbs. The tsx probe of parseHandoff on db2d5dd turns each of these into [], where the base kept them as work: 'Nothing the task requires has been tested', 'Nothing the brief asks for is tested', 'Nothing for the task's criteria is verified', 'Nothing that the criteria require is checked', 'Nothing the task needs is deployed', 'Nothing the criteria require is in the repository', 'Nothing in the scope is tested'. Such a task goes to review instead of pausing. It follows the spec's WHOLE_SET decision literally, but the fixer's own WORK_STATE intent misses it. Widen WORK_STATE to passive states ('is/has been <verb>ed', 'is in ...'), or allow nothing after the noun phrase but a reason.

Under an outer limit the session status and result read 'Stopped at the project's budget' and '... Stopped at the project's budget of CHF 0.06. CHF 0.02.' while a third of that budget is spent; the Sessions row is '1 paused · Stopped at the project's budget · CHF 0.02'. This is the L4-money-102 sibling for project/month pauses that now wrap up early. The card also says 'Ready again once you raise the project's budget' while CHF 0.04 of it is left (most of it is kept for the review).

The 'Left for next time: ...; this session's CHF X was used.' branch in result.ts (~:502-512) can still fire for after_others items when a larger task's pause ends the session with room left ('room' case). This 'budget used' sibling is not covered.
